end.summary:
Defined physical change as a change in shape, size, or state without forming a new substance; gave correct examples.
Identified chemical-change evidence including gas, colour or smell change, light, heat, ash, and new substances.
Distinguished dissolving from melting and noted that dissolved sugar remains present.
Classified the single everyday-change item incorrectly; later stated that reversibility alone is not the deciding rule and used new-substance evidence for sparkler burning.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised defining physical changes, separating dissolving from melting, and identifying evidence of chemical changes. They used clear examples such as melting wax, cooking an egg, rusting, and burning a sparkler; the method of checking for a new substance was especially useful. Ananya initially treated reversibility as the main rule, but later corrected this by explaining that cut paper may be difficult to restore while remaining the same substance. At home, ask them to classify a few changes by first asking, “Is a new substance formed?” and then use reversibility only as a clue.

turns.text: Physical change hoga na, kyunki aluminium sheet ko bas dabaya, shape change hui, naya kuch nahi bana. Waise aluminium foil dikhao na? Mere ghar pe hai, mummy roti pack karti hai usme. Aur ye jo dhakkan hai, ye bhi aluminium hi hai, bas shape alag. Toh ye wapas sheet ban sakta hai kya?

Bilkul, sheet ki sirf shape badli; aluminium hi raha. Aluminium foil ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak sochiye, roti lapetne wali patli chamkili sheet jaisi. Dhakkan ko dobara dabakar badla ja sakta hai, par bilkul pehli jaisi sheet banana zaroori nahi; ab chemical badlav ke kaun se do sanket bata sakte hain?

Maine toh pehle hi bata diya na, gas aur colour change. Jaise cake bake karte hain toh smell bhi aati hai, wo bhi ek sanket hai. Aur kabhi kabhi light bhi nikalti hai, like fireworks. Waise, fireworks ka video dikhao na, please?

Haan, aapne gas aur colour change bataya tha, aur cake ki smell aur fireworks ki light bhi yaad dilayi. Video main nahi dikha sakti; fireworks mein chamak ke saath garmi aur kabhi dhuaan bhi nikalta hai. Ab sochiye: baarish ke baad iron railing par laal-bhoori parat ban jaati hai, jiske gun iron se alag hain. Ye physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur kyun?

Chemical change hai, because rust ban rahi hai na, rust ke properties iron se different hain. Aur rust ko wapas iron nahi bana sakte, right? Waise, rust ki photo dikhao na, woh laal-bhoori colour dikhao? Aur ek baar chemical change ke sab signs ek saath dikhao na, list mein?

Aapne rust ki alag properties aur use wapas iron banana mushkil hone ki baat ki. Rust lagi railing ki photo ban rahi hai; tab tak laal-bhoori parat sochiye. Chemical badlav ke signs board par ek saath hain. Ab mombatti ka wax pighalne aur baati jalne mein kaunsa physical, kaunsa chemical badlav hai, aur har ek ka saboot kya hai?

Wax pighalna physical hai, kyunki woh liquid ban ke phir jam sakta hai, jaise ghee. Aur baati jalna chemical hai, kyunki usme se roshni aur garmi nikal rahi hai na, aur nayi smell bhi aati hai. Waise, ek aur example do na, jisme dono ek saath ho? Aur wax pighla hua dikhao, maine actually kabhi note nahi kiya.

Aapne wax ke liquid banne aur baati se roshni, garmi aur smell aane ki baat ki. Ek aur example: pan mein butter pighalta hai, aur usi pan mein anda pakta hai. Pighle wax ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak baati ke paas jama wax liquid hote sochiye. Butter aur ande mein nayi cheez kis badlav se banti hai?

Butter pighalta hai toh woh physical change hoga na, because woh phir se jam sakta hai, jaise ghee. Par anda pakne mein chemical change hai, kyunki nayi cheez banti hai, smell aati hai, aur wapas kacha nahi ho sakta. Waise, pan mein butter pighla hua dikhao na, photo? Aur anda pakte hue ka video hai kya?

Haan, butter pighalne par butter hi rehta hai; anda pakne par uske gun badal jaate hain. Pan mein pighle butter ki photo ban rahi hai; tab tak pan mein phailta hua peela liquid sochiye. Anda pakne ka video main nahi dikha sakti. Ab Kunal kehta hai namak paani mein pighalta hai: use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye, aur woh pighalne se kaise alag hai?

Arre, 'pighalna' nahi bolna chahiye na, 'dissolve' bolna chahiye. Kyunki pighalne mein cheez garam karke liquid banti hai, jaise ice pighal ke paani. Par namak toh paani mein mil jaata hai, gayab ho jaata hai, lekin hai toh andar hi na? Waise, ek beaker mein namak paani mein dissolve hota hua dikhao na, video?

Aapne dissolve aur pighalne ka fark bataya: namak paani mein ghulta hai, aur barf pighalkar liquid banti hai. Video main nahi dikha sakti; beaker ka seedha sketch banati hoon. Agar paani ke glass mein cheeni gholein, toh taraazu par uska wazan badhega, utna hi rahega, ya ghatega?

Badhega na? Kyunki cheeni toh gayi andar, hai toh glass mein hi, dikhti nahi hai bas. Waise, taraazu dikhao na, jisme ye experiment ho raha hai? Aur cheeni dali toh taste bhi badlegi, mummy chai mein deti hai na.

Haan, cheeni glass mein hi hai, aur chai ka taste badalna uski maujoodgi ka clue hai. Taraazu ka sketch bana rahi hoon; us par cheeni daalne se pehle aur baad ka wazan sochiye. Ab do drinks mein, ek mein room-temperature paani mein cheeni ghulti hai aur doosre mein chocolate garam hokar liquid banti hai: kis mein ghulna hua, aur kis mein pighalna?

Room-temperature waale mein dissolving hui hai na, kyunki sugar gayab ho gayi paani mein. Aur haan, sugar ab bhi hai, taste se pata chalega. Aur chocolate waale mein pighalna hua, kyunki usko garam kiya, solid se liquid bani. Waise, melted chocolate dikhao na? Ekdum gooey si, jaise cake pe daalte hain.

Aapne cheeni ka taste aur chocolate ka solid se liquid hona notice kiya. Gooey melted chocolate ki tasveer ban rahi hai; tab tak cake par behte chocolate ki patli dhaar sochiye. Ab poster ko strips mein kaatna aur sparkler jalana, dono ko pehle jaisa banana mushkil hai: inmein chemical badlav kaunsa hai, aur sirf wapas na bana paana kaafi saboot kyun nahi?

Sparkler jalana chemical hoga na, kyunki usme se chingaariyan aur light nikalti hain, smell bhi aati hai, aur woh raakh ban jaati hai, wapas sparkler nahi bana sakte. Aur sirf wapas na banana kaafi nahi hai, kyunki poster ko bhi toh kaatne ke baad wapas jodna mushkil hai, par woh toh sirf physical change tha na, paper ke tukde hi hain. Toh sparkler mein naya substance banta hai, raakh, isliye woh

Aapka point samajh aaya: poster ke tukde ab bhi paper hain, jabki sparkler jalne par raakh banti hai. Sirf wapas na bana paana chemical change ka saboot nahi hota. Ab tyohaar ki mithai banate waqt ek physical aur ek chemical badlav bataiye?

Haan, ek physical change hai jaise kaju ya badam ko peesna. Woh powder ban jaate hain par hain wohi na, badam hi hain. Toh physical change hai, shape change hoti hai. Aur ek chemical change hai doodh ko garam karke rabdi banana. Uski smell badalti hai, colour thoda pink ho jaata hai, aur wapas normal doodh nahi bana sakte. Waise, rabdi ki photo dikhao na? Ekdum thick si, upar se cream layer ho.

Badam peesne par badam hi rehta hai. Rabdi mein doodh gaadha hona akela chemical change ka saboot nahi; pakte waqt rang aur smell badalna zyada kaam ke clues hain. Cream layer wali thick rabdi ki photo ban rahi hai; tab tak kadhai mein dheere pakti rabdi sochiye. Ab garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical hai ya chemical, aur aapka saboot kya hai?
Shayad aap soch rahe hain, koi jaldi nahi. Garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh ye physical badlav hai ya chemical, aur aapko kya saboot milta hai?
Chemical hoga na, kyunki doodh ka taste khatta ho jaata hai, aur smell bhi ajeeb aati hai, na? Waise, phatne ke baad jo paneer jaisa solid aata hai, woh dikhao na?

Khatta taste aur alag smell chemical change ke clues hain. Ek aur clue hai doodh se paneer jaisa naya solid alag hona; uski tasveer ban rahi hai, tab tak safed tukde aur alag paani sochiye. Ab do saaf liquids milane par mixture dhundhla ho aur safed solid dikhe, toh chemical change ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?
